_meta.name: English
page.home.desc: Start the game and watch the translation here.
page.history.desc: Every line this session: search, copy, retranslate, export.
page.roi.desc: Pick where subtitles appear and tune OCR while watching what it sees and reads. You can also drag on the video to draw the region.
page.translate.desc: Which engine translates subtitles, the Gemini key and context. Without a key the free Google Translate takes over.
page.appearance.desc: Subtitle font, size, colors and position.
page.profiles.desc: Per-game region, glossary and ignored phrases.
page.web.desc: Show the translation on a phone, tablet or in OBS.
page.device.desc: Capture card, audio input and A/V sync.
page.diagnostics.desc: Live metrics, graphs and bug report.
common.coming_soon.title: Under construction
settings.theme.desc: Dark, light, or follow the Windows setting.
settings.close_to_tray.desc: Closing the window does not stop SubWizard; quit from the tray icon.
error.file_not_found: Video file not found: {path}. Make sure it has not been moved or deleted.
error.file_unreadable: Could not open the video file: {path}. It may be damaged or in an unsupported format; try .mp4 (H.264).
error.file_not_set: No video file selected. Pick one on the Device & Audio page.
error.source_unsupported: The '{kind}' source is not supported yet.
error.capture_not_found: Capture card not found. Make sure the cable is in a USB 3.0 port and no other program (OBS etc.) is using the device.
error.capture_name_not_found: No capture card named '{name}'. Check that it is plugged in, or pick it again on the Device & Audio page.
error.capture_lost: Lost the capture card. Check the cable; trying to reconnect.
error.audio_open: Could not open the audio device. Make sure it is plugged in and no other program has exclusive use of it. ({detail})
error.audio_input_missing: Audio input '{name}' not found. Check that the capture card is plugged in, or pick it again on the Device & Audio page.
hint.select_mjpg: Select the MJPG format; YUY2 cannot reach 60 FPS at 1080p on most cards.
hint.usb3_port: Plug the capture card into a USB 3.0 (blue) port; on USB 2.0 resolution and FPS drop.
hint.mode_unsupported: The card does not support the requested mode; pick a supported one from the mode list.
cli.no_video_devices: (none found — device listing works on Windows only)
home.video.stopped: Press Start to see the picture.
home.status_line: Source {source} FPS · Render {render} FPS · Frame age {age} ms
audio.no_signal: No audio is arriving. Check the HDMI cable and that the PS5 outputs audio over HDMI; make sure the right audio input is selected.
audio.clipping: The audio input is clipping (0 dB). Lower the capture card's input level in Windows sound settings.
device.kind.desc: From the console via capture card, or a recorded video for trying things out.
device.capture.desc: If it is missing, check the cable and refresh.
device.capture.desc_unlisted: Devices could not be listed by name; pick by index.
device.mode.desc: Resolution, frame rate and format. 1080p60 MJPG is recommended.
device.mode.title: Requested vs. actual mode
device.fps_low: Measured frame rate ({fps}) is below the target ({target}). Use a USB 3.0 port, select MJPG and close other programs using the device.
device.audio.enabled.desc: Routes the capture card's audio to your speakers. Turn off if you listen on the TV.
device.vu.desc: Left / right channel. If it reaches red the sound distorts.
device.muted.desc: Silences the PC; avoids doubled audio when listening on the TV.
device.profile.desc: If the sound crackles or drops out, move to a safer profile.
device.delay.desc: Increase if sound arrives before the picture. Audible immediately.
device.delay.negative: Audio can only be delayed, not advanced; negative values are not applied. If the picture lags the sound, use a USB 3.0 port and select MJPG.
diag.legend: Green: on target · Yellow: borderline · Red: problem
roi.placeholder: No picture. Press Start on Home, or open calibration with F2.
roi.notice.stopped: Not running. Press Start on Home to see OCR.
roi.notice.error: OCR could not start: {error}. Try reinstalling; if it persists, copy the report from Diagnostics.
roi.notice.no_video: No picture from the source; check the Device & Audio page.
roi.padding.desc: Grows the region on every side so letters at the edge are not cut off (dashed line).
roi.hz.desc: Checks per second. OCR only runs when the region changes, so higher values cost CPU only while subtitles change.
roi.min_confidence.desc: Lines below this are ignored (background text, noise).
roi.white_mask.desc: Removes everything except bright, colorless pixels. Helps white subtitles over busy backgrounds; keep off for colored subtitles.
roi.contrast.desc: Makes faint text stand out. Most games do not need it.
calib.hint:
Drag a rectangle over the subtitle.
Enter: save · Esc: cancel · 1-4: templates
translate.engine.desc: Gemini gives natural, context-aware translations (needs an API key). Google Translate is free but more literal.
translate.model.desc: flash-lite is the fastest and cheapest; try a larger model if quality is not enough.
translate.keys.desc: Separate several keys with commas; the next is used when one hits its quota. Keys are kept in the OS credential store, not in the config file.
translate.notice.no_key_fallback: No Gemini key: translations use the free Google Translate (lower quality).
translate.notice.no_key: No Gemini key and the fallback is off: subtitles will not be translated. Add a key or turn the fallback on.
translate.context.desc: How many previous lines go to the model as context (consistent names, address and tone).
translate.fallback.desc: When Gemini fails, times out or has no key, Google Translate is used; the subtitle shows "(fallback)".
translate.test.failed: Could not translate. Check your internet connection and the key.
translate.cache.desc: {n} lines translated before; the same line never goes to the API again.
translate.usage.desc: Gemini requests, cache hits and estimated cost.
appearance.preview.source: Keep your head down, cops are everywhere.
appearance.presets.desc: Set colors, size and background in one click.
appearance.visible.desc: Translation keeps running, it is just not drawn (F10).
appearance.position.desc: Above the original, at the top, or in place of the English text.
appearance.font.desc: Empty: Segoe UI Variable → Segoe UI → Arial.
appearance.size.desc: Percent of the video height; looks the same windowed and full screen.
appearance.width.desc: Long lines wrap at this width.
appearance.bold.desc: Bold text reads better from the couch.
appearance.outline.desc: A thin black edge around letters, for bright scenes.
appearance.auto_bg.desc: In "replace" mode, cover the English text with the color around it.
appearance.show_source.desc: The original line in small type under the translation.
hotkeys.global: Work while the game has focus
hotkeys.global_unsupported: Global hotkeys work on Windows only; here they work inside the app.
hotkeys.conflict: {combo} is bound to more than one action: {actions}.
hotkeys.action.calibrate.desc: Freezes the frame so you can draw the subtitle region.
hotkeys.action.retranslate.desc: Translates the line on screen again, skipping the cache.
hotkeys.action.pause_translation.desc: Video keeps running, new lines are not translated.
hotkeys.action.history_panel.desc: The last lines over the video.
